description: This Java class 'PublicKeyIdWithIssuer' encapsulates a public key identifier along with its issuer, providing factory method, getters, and overridden methods for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: PublicKeyIdWithIssuer
classes.description: An immutable class representing a public key ID with an associated issuer, used within the security cache of the gateway service.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance, requiring non-null keyId and issuer.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the key.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on keyId and issuer.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on keyId and issuer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation including class name, keyId, and issuer.
